name: Otaria
description: Otaria is a long, thin north-south continent on Dominaria, the primary location for the Odyssey and Onslaught blocks.

summary.text: Otaria is a long, thin north-south continent on Dominaria, the primary location for the Odyssey and Onslaught blocks.

citations.text: "Otaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: The earliest humans overthrew the Primeval Dragons and formed a huge empire based in Otaria, and the continent survived the Phyrexian Invasion relatively unscathed and took in refugees.

citations.text: "Otaria", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Otaria", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: A century after the Invasion the Mirari appeared and started wars that devastated the continent, while the Cabal controlled most of its land and wealth through pit fights and the Order tried to break its hold.

citations.text: "Otaria", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Odyssey", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Odyssey", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Emperor Aboshan used the Mirari to flood the northern third of Otaria, and Kirtar's spell destroyed the Order's citadel, killing Pianna and himself.

citations.text: "Mirari", section "Discovery". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Pianna", section "Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Kamahl, dominated by the Mirari, tried to unite the tribes by force and wounded his sister Jeska, whom the Cabal then changed into Phage.

citations.text: "Kamahl", section "Kamahl and the Mirari". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Kamahl", section "Kamahl and the Mirari". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Onslaught", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Phage and Akroma's war ended when Kamahl's Soul Reaper fused them and Zagorka into the goddess Karona, whose war ravaged the continent until Sash and Waistcoat pierced her with the Mirari-sword.

citations.text: "Karona", section "Karona Reborn (c.4306 AR)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Karona's War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Karona's War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Karona's death created the Otarian rift, which Jeska closed, beginning the Great Mending.

citations.text: "Rift", section "Otarian rift". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Rift", section "Otarian rift". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Jeska", section "Planeswalker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Much later the Weatherlight crash-landed in Otaria during the Phyrexian invasion of Dominaria.

citations.text: "Shards of Nightmares" by Phoebe Barton. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.

status.text: Otaria is a ruined continent, and the latest story shows the corrupted Weatherlight escaping from it.

citations.text: Dominaria Remastered: card flavor text (Dominaria Remastered, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
"Shards of Nightmares" by Phoebe Barton. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Humans on Dominaria overthrow their cruel draconic masters, the Primeval Dragons, and form a large empire based in Otaria.
timeline.quote: These people overthrew their draconic masters and formed a large empire based in Otaria

citation.text: "Human", section "Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Orggs are known to exist on Otaria around 4050 AR, possibly created by the Cabal.
timeline.quote: It is possible that they were created by the Cabal to fight in their pits.

citation.text: "Orgg", section "Lore". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Balthor survives the Phyrexian Invasion and retrieves Urza's staff.
timeline.quote: managing to retrieve nothing less than Urza 's staff

citation.text: "Balthor Rockfist", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Balthor meets Matoc, they kill the warhounds and travel home to Otaria, where Balthor joins Matoc's clan.
timeline.quote: The barbarian invited Balthor to join his clan.

citation.text: "Balthor Rockfist", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Balthor forges Matoc a blade from Urza's staff.
timeline.quote: Balthor forged Matoc a blade from Urza's Staff.

citation.text: "Balthor Rockfist", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Radha and Venser accompany Jeska to the Otarian rift, where Jeska's final act closes all rifts.
timeline.quote: Jeska's final act closed the Otarian rift, as well as all others.

citation.text: "Radha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Balthor travels with Jeska to Cabal City to find Kamahl and fights in the pits, without success.
timeline.quote: briefly fighting in the pits alongside her

citation.text: "Balthor Rockfist", section "A New Home". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Balthor opposes Kamahl when the Mirari drives him to take over all the tribes; Jeska is mortally wounded and Kamahl comes to his senses.
timeline.quote: Following Jeska's mortal wounding, Kamahl snapped out of the Mirari's influence

citation.text: "Balthor Rockfist", section "A New Home". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Karona War displaces Otarian aven, whose descendants settle New Argive and Benalia.
timeline.quote: The Aven of New Argive and Benalia are the descendants of refugees displaced by the cataclysmic Karona War

citation.text: "Bird", section "Aven". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Mirari's magic mutates Otarian aven and owl aven into larger, taloned forms.
timeline.quote: As the Mirari 's magic washed across Otaria, altering its inhabitants, many aven became taller and more muscular

citation.text: "Bird", section "Aven". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Around the Time Spiral crisis, Otarian aven are reduced to squatters in the continent's ruins.
timeline.quote: Around the time of the Time Spiral crisis, the aven were reduced to squatters in the continent's ruins.

citation.text: "Bird", section "Aven". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Virot Maglan founds the Cabal in the wake of the collapse of Suderbod, focused on commerce.
timeline.quote: The Cabal was founded by Virot Maglan in 4050 AR

citation.text: "Cabal", section "Foundation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the Phyrexian Invasion the Cabal's pit fights grow in popularity, greatly expanding its wealth and influence.
timeline.quote: resulting in a major expansion in the wealth and influence of the Cabal

citation.text: "Cabal", section "Pit fights". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Virot Maglan pacts with Kuberr and founds the Cabal.
timeline.quote: Virot Maglan sealed a pact with the god Kuberr and gained the power to kill using touch

citation.text: "Cabal City", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Under the Mirari's influence Kamahl goes berserk, slaying most of his kin and dealing Jeska a horrific blow.
timeline.quote: Kamahl lost control and went berserk, slaying most of his kin and striking a horrific blow against Jeska

citation.text: "Jeska", section "Barbarian". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Braids captures the dying Jeska and brings her to the Cabal Patriarch.
timeline.quote: she ultimately was captured by Braids and brought to the Cabal Patriarch

citation.text: "Jeska", section "Barbarian". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Patriarch's attempt to destroy Jeska instead gives birth to Phage the Untouchable.
timeline.quote: attempt to destroy Jeska instead gave birth to Phage the Untouchable

citation.text: "Jeska", section "Phage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ixidor's dream magic sends the deathwurms out of Phage, leaving her Jeska again.
timeline.quote: those deathwurms were sent out into the world, leaving her once again Jeska

citation.text: "Jeska", section "Phage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: To save the land Jeska pulls the deathwurms back into herself, damning herself to life as Phage.
timeline.quote: she pulled them back into herself, damning herself to a life as Phage

citation.text: "Jeska", section "Phage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The surviving wurm containing Nivea consumes Ixidor so he can rest with his love.
timeline.quote: that wurm consumed Ixidor, so he could rest with his love forever

citation.text: "Jeska", section "Phage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kamahl's Soul Reaper kills Akroma and Phage and accidentally Zagorka, their essences forming Karona.
timeline.quote: The essence of the three women blended into a new being

citation.text: "Jeska", section "Phage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kirtar uses the Mirari to crystallize much of the Order's fortress, including himself and Captain Pianna; Laquatus ends up with the Mirari.
timeline.quote: Kirtar used the device to cast a devastating spell that crystallized much of the fortress

citation.text: "Kamahl", section "Kamahl's Odyssey". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Emperor Aboshan uses the Mirari to cause a tidal wave that devastates northern Otaria while Kamahl trains youths in Breaker Bay.
timeline.quote: Emperor Aboshan used the Mirari to cause a tidal wave that devastated the northern third of Otaria.

citation.text: "Kamahl", section "Kamahl's Odyssey". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chainer finds the Mirari in an old mansion and gives it to the First as a tournament prize.
timeline.quote: The Mirari was found by Chainer in an old mansion

citation.text: "Mirari", section "Discovery". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kirtar claims the Mirari to destroy it but is corrupted and uses it to kill Pianna.
timeline.quote: Instead, he took it to the Order's citadel and used it to kill Pianna

citation.text: "Mirari", section "Discovery". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kirtar's uncontrolled spell devastates the citadel and kills him.
timeline.quote: Kirtar was unable to end his spell, which went on to devastate the citadel and kill the Lieutenant.

citation.text: "Mirari", section "Discovery". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Turg gives the Mirari to Captain Satas, who takes it to Emperor Aboshan.
timeline.quote: Turg gave the Mirari to Captain Satas

citation.text: "Mirari", section "Discovery". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Aboshan pours mana into the Mirari, flooding the northern third of Otaria; the spell destroys the capital and kills him.
timeline.quote: He poured mana into the Mirari to try to make the vision a reality, creating a massive wave that flooded the northern third of Otaria.

citation.text: "Mirari", section "Discovery". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Braids takes the Mirari back to the Patriarch.
timeline.quote: fell into the hands of Braids

citation.text: "Mirari", section "Discovery". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chainer uses the Mirari to heal Kamahl and then to overthrow the Patriarch and exile him to Aphetto.
timeline.quote: he used it to overthrow the Cabal Patriarch and exile him to Aphetto

citation.text: "Mirari", section "Problems in Cabal City". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chainer is overloaded by the Mirari in a battle with Kamahl, unleashing dementia horrors, and dies.
timeline.quote: he was overwhelmed by his own spell and died.

citation.text: "Mirari", section "Problems in Cabal City". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kamahl attaches the Mirari to his sword and tries to unite the Pardic barbarians by force.
timeline.quote: He attached it to the pommel of his sword and tried to use its power to unite the Pardic barbarians under his rule.

citation.text: "Mirari", section "Problems in Cabal City". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kamahl mortally wounds his sister Jeska with the Mirari-enhanced sword.
timeline.quote: he used his Mirari-enhanced sword to mortally wound Jeska

citation.text: "Mirari", section "Problems in Cabal City". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kamahl plants the Mirari in Krosa; its power soaks into the continent and mutates the inhabitants, driving forest beasts mad.
timeline.quote: it was he who planted the Mirari there thinking that without a wielder the artifact would be harmless.

citation.text: "Mutant", section "Otarian Mutants". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Mirari's magic washes across Otaria, making many aven taller and more muscular with razor-like talons.
timeline.quote: many aven became taller and more muscular

citation.text: "Mutant", section "Otarian Mutants". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Odyssey storyline begins on Otaria a century after the Phyrexian Invasion, introducing Kamahl as protagonist.
timeline.quote: it introduces Kamahl as a protagonist

citation.text: "Odyssey". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Cabal controls most of the land and wealth, running pit fights for the masses.
timeline.quote: it operates pit fights for entertainment of the masses and, for the one lucky pit warrior who survives, fame and fortune

citation.text: "Odyssey", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Order strives to break the Cabal's iron fist over the populace.
timeline.quote: strives to break the Cabal's iron fist over the populace

citation.text: "Odyssey", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Mer Empire schemes for absolute control by flooding the continent and killing the "inferior air-breathers".
timeline.quote: scheme for absolute control of the continent by flooding the continent and killing the "inferior air-breathers"

citation.text: "Odyssey", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The earliest humans overthrow the Primeval Dragons and form a huge empire based in Otaria.
timeline.quote: These people overthrew their draconic masters and formed a huge empire based in Otaria.

citation.text: "Otaria", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Otaria survives the Phyrexian Invasion relatively unscathed and takes in refugees.
timeline.quote: It had survived that war relatively unscathed and was one of the first areas to recover and grow powerful once more.

citation.text: "Otaria", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A century after the Invasion the Mirari appears, starting wars that devastate the continent.
timeline.quote: A century after the Invasion, the Mirari appeared there, initiating a series of destructive wars that devastated much of the continent.

citation.text: "Otaria", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The destruction sends Otaria's aven fleeing to Benalia and New Argive.
timeline.quote: This massive destruction sent Otaria's aven population fleeing to Benalia and New Argive .

citation.text: "Otaria", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Pianna is orphaned when barbarian raiders massacre her family; she is saved by Lord Eagyn and given to Kort.
timeline.quote: She escaped the fate of her family by hiding in the chimney

citation.text: "Pianna", section "Rise to leadership". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karona is destroyed at the climax of Karona's War, creating the Otarian rift.
timeline.quote: The last major rift to come into existence was created at the climax of Karona's War

citation.text: "Rift", section "Otarian rift". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: With the Otarian rift closed by Jeska, the Great Mending begins.
timeline.quote: With the last major rift sealed, the Great Mending began.

citation.text: "Rift", section "Otarian rift". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Turg is captured and psychically grafted to Laquatus, becoming more intelligent.
timeline.quote: rigorously trained to be Laquatus's servant by being psychically grafted to the merman

citation.text: "Turg", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Turg first fights Seton and Kamahl while Laquatus pursues Kirtar across Otaria's northern plains.
timeline.quote: Turg briefly fought them but withdrew at Laquatus's command

citation.text: "Turg", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Turg's eggs yield a tadpole, Uurg, who escapes the Cabal and roams Otaria.
timeline.quote: one of the tadpoles escaped their control

citation.text: "Turg", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teroh vows to be the holy wind that avenges the Cabal's victims.
timeline.quote: I am the holy wind that shall avenge the Cabal's victims.

citation.text: Major Teroh (Torment, 2002), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Mirari pulses in the Cabal's vault and spreads darkness over Otaria.
timeline.quote: Deep within the Cabal's vault, the Mirari pulsed like a dead sun—and its darkness radiated across Otaria.

citation.text: Cabal Coffers (Torment, 2002), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Chainer's insanity touches nearly every living thing.
timeline.quote: Chainer's insanity touched nearly every living thing

citation.text: Waste Away (Torment, 2002), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Chainer discovers the Mirari and rises through the Cabal, rivaling the Patriarch before his fall; Kamahl befriends him and Laquatus plots to seize the Mer Empire.
timeline.quote: Chainer's Torment presents the tale of Chainer , a Cabal dementia summoner, discovering the Mirari and rising through the ranks of the Cabal

citation.text: "Torment", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The reincarnated Kuberr takes over the Cabal after the Patriarch's death.
timeline.quote: The reincarnated Kuberr took over the Cabal after the Patriarch's death.

citation.text: "Cabal", section "Reign of Kuberr". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Karona's War the Cabal is left with no leader and no god and is presumed defunct around 4500 AR.
timeline.quote: the Cabal was left with no leader and no god

citation.text: "Cabal", section "Reign of Kuberr". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kamahl keeps the Mirari safe from others and himself, keeping his promise to a dying Chainer.
timeline.quote: keeps the Mirari safe from others and himself

citation.text: "Judgment", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Laquatus and Eesha try to obtain the Mirari while Jeska and Balthor try to separate it from Kamahl for fear of its corrupting influence.
timeline.quote: attempt to obtain the potent orb for themselves

citation.text: "Judgment", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A majority of the characters are killed and the influence of the Mirari on individuals is diminished.
timeline.quote: A majority of the characters are killed

citation.text: "Judgment", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kamahl keeps his promise to the dying Chainer and takes the Mirari, attaching it to his sword and fighting off challengers on his way home.
timeline.quote: he takes the Mirari orb for safekeeping.

citation.text: "Judgment (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Laquatus, trapped by Llawan's mages and failing diplomatically with the Order and the Cabal, goes to the mainland with Burke to retrieve the Mirari.
timeline.quote: Laquatus and his jack Burke go personally to the mainland to retrieve the Mirari

citation.text: "Judgment (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kamahl returns home, is dominated by the Mirari and tries to take all the tribes under his dictatorship, dividing the barbarians.
timeline.quote: Initially, he was content simply to return home covered in glory, but inevitably, the Mirari dominated his mind.

citation.text: "Kamahl", section "Kamahl and the Mirari". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In battle Kamahl impales Jeska with the Mirari-sword, leaving an incurable wound; shocked, he resolves to be rid of the Mirari.
timeline.quote: Kamahl viciously impaling Jeska with his Mirari-sword

citation.text: "Kamahl", section "Kamahl and the Mirari". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Mirari pours energy into Krosa, mutating creatures and plants across Otaria.
timeline.quote: the Mirari now began pouring energy into Krosa

citation.text: "Mirari", section "Krosa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karona is betrayed and killed by her minions Sash and Waistcoat, releasing Jeska, who becomes a planeswalker.
timeline.quote: killing Karona and releasing Jeska, who then became a planeswalker.

citation.text: "Mirari", section "Krosa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karn reveals the Mirari's origins and takes it back to Argentum.
timeline.quote: Karn appeared and revealed the Mirari's humble origins and took it back to Argentum

citation.text: "Mirari", section "Krosa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Pianna maps the attacks, finds they match Kirtar's route, and asks him to destroy the Mirari; he refuses and plots a coup.
timeline.quote: He instead organized a coup against Pianna by his fellow aven warriors

citation.text: "Pianna", section "Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kirtar traps Pianna in solid crystal with the Mirari, killing her; the spell destroys the citadel and Kirtar.
timeline.quote: Kirtar used the Mirari to trap Pianna in a solid crystal, instantly killing her

citation.text: "Pianna", section "Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bretath becomes interim Captain; the Sword of Leadership passes to Teroh, then Commander Eesha.
timeline.quote: Teroh was killed by Chainer before this could be effected

citation.text: "Pianna", section "Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Mirari falls into Kamahl's hands, and his actions inadvertently lead to the Rebirth of Karona.
timeline.quote: saw it eventually falling into the hands of Kamahl , whose actions inadvertently led to the Rebirth of Karona

citation.text: "Rift Era", section "Rise and Fall of Karona". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karona's War triggers a final time rift formation across Otaria, and her brief reign ends in her destruction.
timeline.quote: Her brief, unstable reign ended in her destruction, but the damage to the plane's leylines was done.

citation.text: "Rift Era", section "Rise and Fall of Karona". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Akroma, created by Ixidor's imagination, treats clerics as allies in her war against Phage.
timeline.quote: She saw them only as allies in her war against Phage.

citation.text: Akroma's Blessing (Onslaught, 2002), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ixidor imagines the ruin of enemies and Akroma makes it so.
timeline.quote: Ixidor had only to imagine their ruin and Akroma made it so.

citation.text: Akroma's Vengeance (Onslaught, 2002), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Akroma vows to stay her hand only when Phage is destroyed.
timeline.quote: Until the world unites in vengeful fury and Phage is destroyed, I will not stay my hand.

citation.text: Righteous Cause (Onslaught, 2002), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Phage drains her victims' energy and a faint memory of Jeska stirs before she is lost again.
timeline.quote: As Phage drank their energy, a vague memory of Jeska stirred.

citation.text: Syphon Soul (Onslaught, 2002), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Order clerics contain the Mirari's energy to delay Otaria's demise.
timeline.quote: Every day, Order clerics contain as much of the Mirari's energy as possible, hoping to delay Otaria's demise.

citation.text: Aura Extraction (Onslaught, 2002), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Pacified by Akroma, even born warriors lay down their blades at her feet.
timeline.quote: Even those born to battle could only lay their blades at Akroma's feet.

citation.text: Pacifism (Onslaught, 2002), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Cabal healing magic transforms Jeska into Phage, a pit fighter whose touch brings death.
timeline.quote: Kamahl's sister Jeska is transformed by foul Cabal healing magic, into Phage

citation.text: "Onslaught", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ixidor discovers his reality-sculpting powers and uses them to create the angel Akroma.
timeline.quote: Ixidor uses his new power to create the angel Akroma .

citation.text: "Onslaught", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The first sliver slips out of Riptide in the form of a junior researcher.
timeline.quote: Taking the form of a junior researcher, the first sliver slipped out of Riptide.

citation.text: Mistform Sliver (Legions, 2003), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The slivers break free of the Riptide Project and adapt to life on Otaria.
timeline.quote: After breaking free from the Riptide Project, the slivers quickly adapted to life on Otaria

citation.text: Blade Sliver (Legions, 2003), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Riptide Project loses control of its last slivers and the island is overrun.
timeline.quote: there was nothing to keep the island from being completely overrun.

citation.text: Shifting Sliver (Legions, 2003), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: More slivers nest in Otaria within weeks than ever existed on Rath.
timeline.quote: Within weeks, more slivers nested in Otaria than ever existed on Rath.

citation.text: Brood Sliver (Legions, 2003), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Akroma asks her troops for unwavering loyalty.
timeline.quote: Akroma asked for only one thing from her troops: unwavering, unconditional loyalty.

citation.text: Akroma's Devoted (Legions, 2003), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kamahl and the Cabal, in an uneasy alliance, set out to defeat Akroma.
timeline.quote: Kamahl and the Cabal , in an uneasy alliance, set out to defeat Akroma .

citation.text: "Legions", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Slivers are reintroduced as clones of the originals through the Riptide Project.
timeline.quote: have been reintroduced as clones of the original slivers as part of the Riptide Project

citation.text: "Legions", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In a final battle between Phage and Akroma, the two and Zagorka merge to form Karona.
timeline.quote: the two beings and Zagorka merge to form Karona

citation.text: "Legions", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citation.text: "Scourge", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kamahl frees his sister Jeska from Karona and Phage.

citation.text: "Scourge", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karn returns to Otaria to take Jeska to Argentum.

citation.text: "Scourge", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kamahl's Soul Reaper fuses Akroma, Phage and Zagorka into the goddess Karona; the armies stop fighting to worship her.

citation.text: "Scourge (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citation.text: "Scourge (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The land drinks power from the Mirari.

timeline.quote: In one huge discharge of her power, she closed them all, allowing the Great Mending to begin.

citation.text: "Jeska", section "Planeswalker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citation.text: "Future Sight (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citation.text: "Future Sight (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citation.text: Rorix Bladewing (Eternal Masters, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The crew finds the Weatherlight grounded in Otaria with cracked moderator rods, and Raff proposes seeking magic in the mountains.

citation.text: "Shards of Nightmares" by Phoebe Barton. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.

timeline.quote: "I help you get inside the barricade, and you help me kill me."

citation.text: "Shards of Nightmares" by Phoebe Barton. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.

citation.text: "Shards of Nightmares" by Phoebe Barton. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: The three emerge on the other side at different times and find the Phyrexian war construct sunk in a crater.
timeline.quote: the half-sunken hulk of a Phyrexian war machine

citation.text: "Shards of Nightmares" by Phoebe Barton. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.

citation.text: "Shards of Nightmares" by Phoebe Barton. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.

citation.text: "Shards of Nightmares" by Phoebe Barton. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.

citation.text: "Aboshan", section "The Battle for the Mirari". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citation.text: "Aboshan Trench", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citation.text: "Karona's War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citation.text: "Nightmare War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
